name: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE)
short_description: Public reference system that assigns identifiers to publicly known software security vulnerabilities. A CVE says a weakness exists in certain software versions but not how urgent it is for a specific organization.

evidence.quote: A scan can give you a list of CVEs, those public labels for known software weaknesses.
A CVE is a public reference number for a known weakness.
新しいCVEが報告される度にデバイス群全体が自動的に再評価されます
включая базы CVE и собственную аналитику угроз Microsoft
हर नया CVE पूरे device बेड़े के सचालित पुनर मिलांकन को trigger करता है
새로운 CVE가 나올 때마다 전체 장치군에 대한 자동 재평가가 트리거됩니다.
Cada nuevo CVE activa una revaluación automática de toda la flota de dispositivos.
Unpatched CVEs sit there politely waiting for an exploit kit
